title: Drive Your Dreams / Long-Term Internship
desc:
At Honda Türkiye, our vision is to continuously grow within Türkiye’s automotive and motorcycle network through the sales and after-sales services we provide.
You may apply to this internship opportunity
by submitting a cover letter
indicating the department
in which you would like to complete your internship.
Departments recruiting interns:
Finance
Information Technologies
Motorcycle PR
Motorcycle Product Planning
Academy
Technical Service
Homologation
Motorcycle Accessories Sales
Qualifications
Currently enrolled in 4th-year of a university degree program
Available to work full-time at least 3 days per week
Strong analytical thinking and communication skills
Good command of English, both written and spoken
Advanced proficiency in MS Office applications
Strong team player with a collaborative mindset
